messages:
emma: Hey folks, planning to adopt in September and have some questions about leave entitlements and paperwork. I'm based in Ireland now but joined Redwood in the US originally. Which country's parental rules apply?
ryan: Congrats, Emma! :tada: I think it's where you're employed when you start the leave, but confirm with people ops so we know statutory pay + Redwood top-up.
casey: Correct — employment location at leave start governs statutory entitlements. For Ireland you'll follow Irish adoptive leave rules if you're on Irish payroll when leave begins.
emma: Got it. I might take 2 weeks of pre-adoption meetings off in August while still on US payroll, then the formal adoption leave starting Sept 1 on Irish payroll. Is splitting like that okay?
casey: Splitting is allowed, but be mindful: any leave taken under US payroll will use US policies/top-up, and the Irish leave will use Irish statutory pay and company top-up rules. We'll need exact payroll cutover dates to avoid gaps.
payroll-bot: FYI: Runbook for cross-border payroll transitions: https://redwood.atlassian.net/l/c/Payroll-Crossborder. Ensure last US pay date and first Ireland pay date are recorded.
benefits: Also check pension and health coverage transitions — contributions and employer matching operate per-country and might require opt-ins. We'll send you enrolment forms for Ireland.
ryan: On the operational side, we'll need a coverage plan. Emma, can you outline tasks you want paused vs handed off? We may hire a short-term contractor to cover priority work.
emma: I can hand off oncall and customer escalations. Prefer to keep one small ongoing project but move deadlines. I can do a 10-day overlap for knowledge transfer.
casey: Action items: 1) Emma to confirm requested leave start/end dates in HR portal, 2) Emma to upload adoption placement docs, 3) People Ops to confirm payroll cutover and statutory calculations, 4) Manager to propose backfill scope.
casey: Example HR portal note you can paste: 
``nEmployee: Emma R.
Current payroll: US (last pay date: 2025-08-15)
New payroll: Ireland (start date: 2025-08-18)
Requested adoptive leave start: 2025-09-01
Requested pre-adoption time off: 2025-08-20 to 2025-09-01
Notes: Please advise statutory pay and Redwood top-up for both jurisdictions; coordinate pension transfer and benefits enrolment.
```
payroll-bot: Ticket created: HR-6442 Cross-border adoption leave (assigned: casey).
emma: Thanks team — I'll file the portal request tonight and attach the timeline from the agency. Appreciate the clarity. :heart:
